ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a benzene ring connected to an oxygen atom, and the oxygen atom is further connected to AlCl3, with a negative sign marked beside the whole; on the right side of the figure is an R-C-O fragment, with a positive sign marked beside the oxygen, and the bond between C and O is drawn in a multiple-bond form; there are also several curved arrows in the figure, but the problem asks to ignore these arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the structure is divided into two unconnected components. For the right-side R-C≡O+ fragment, replace R with an asterisk as required, written as *C#[O+]. The left side is phenoxy connected to aluminum bearing three chlorine ligands, written as Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)Oc1ccccc1. The two disconnected components are connected with a period in SMILES, therefore obtaining *C#[O+].Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)Oc1ccccc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First visually identify the two disconnected components and discard the curved electron-flow arrows. Encode the right-hand R-C≡O+ fragment by replacing R with '*' and writing the carbon-oxygen triple bond with positive oxygen as *C#[O+]. Then encode the left-hand phenoxy-aluminum chloride complex: benzene attached to O is Oc1ccccc1, that O is bonded to [Al-] bearing three chlorine ligands, giving Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)Oc1ccccc1. Join the two disconnected SMILES components with a period.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环连接到氧原子，氧原子再与 AlCl3 相连，整体旁边标有负号；图中右侧是一个 R-C-O 片段，氧旁标有正号，C 与 O 之间画成多重键形式；图中还有若干弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，结构分成两个不相连的组分。右侧 R-C≡O+ 片段按要求用星号替代 R，写作 *C#[O+]。左侧是苯氧基与带三个氯配体的铝相连，写作 Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)Oc1ccccc1。两个断开的组分在 SMILES 中用句点连接，因此得到 *C#[O+].Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)Oc1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the static chemical species in the image while ignoring all curved arrows: a phenyl ring bonded through oxygen to an AlCl3 unit with formal negative charge on the aluminum-containing complex, plus a separate acylium-like fragment where an R group is attached to carbon triple-bonded to positively charged oxygen.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent an unspecified R substituent as wildcard *, an acylium fragment as *C#[O+], disconnected species with '.', benzene phenoxy as Oc1ccccc1, and tetra-coordinate chlorido/phenoxy aluminate as Cl[Al-](Cl)(Cl)O... with the O connected to the phenyl ring.
